name: Single-Leg Leg Press
form_cues: Weaker (left) leg first; right leg only matches the reps the left earned
Don't lock out at the top; control the descent
notes: Unilateral asymmetry slot: left leg carries -1.6 lbs lean vs right (DEXA 2026-06-24). Left leg gets one extra set.

video_id_query: Single-Leg Leg Press how to proper form
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine and place one foot on the platform, centered mid-platform, with the other foot resting on the floor or frame.
Release the safety bars and lower the platform under control until your knee approaches a 90-degree angle.
Press back to the start by driving through mid-foot, without locking the knee at the top.
Complete all reps with the weaker (left) leg first, then match only that rep count with the right leg.
Re-set the safety pins before exiting the machine.
